---
name: Codebook question or proposal
about: A coding ambiguity, a suggested SJ09 promotion, or pilot/IRR results to share
title: "[CODEBOOK] "
labels: codebook
assignees: ''
---

**Type** (pick one)
- [ ] Coding ambiguity not resolved by Section 8, the Decision Trees (Appendix
      B), or Rule 7
- [ ] Recurring SJ09 ("Other Explicit Source") pattern — possible new SJ
      variable (Rule 9, Section 9)
- [ ] Pilot / inter-rater reliability results to share (Section 10)
- [ ] Other codebook feedback

**Manual version you're using** (e.g., v1.1 — check the title page)

**Description**
Describe the ambiguity, pattern, or result. For a coding ambiguity, include
a de-identified, paraphrased example if possible — please do not paste real,
identifiable participant responses into a public issue.

**For SJ09 promotion proposals**: how many responses / what proportion of
your coded corpus fell into this pattern? What would you name the new
variable, and how would you phrase its operational definition?

**For reliability results**: which variable(s), κ or α value, number of
coders, and pilot sample size?

**Note**: this repository doesn't change the manual's methodology directly —
accepted proposals are incorporated by the authors into a future manual
version, documented in Appendix F (Changelog). See `CONTRIBUTING.md`.
